name: dsh-conversation-search
description: DeepSeek Harness 对话内容搜索插件：在 Web UI 内搜索当前与全部历史会话的消息文本，点击结果自动切换/滚动定位到命中消息并高亮，面板内展示命中消息的前后上下文。Conversation full-text search for DeepSeek Harness: search the current and all historical sessions, click a hit to auto-navigate, scroll to and highlight the matching message, with bounded before/after context in the panel.

meta.title: 对话内容搜索
meta.description: 搜索对话内消息并自动定位到上下文。Search conversation messages and jump to the matching context.
